Installation Guide

Step 1: Download JDK

Go to Oracle’s Java downloads page and download the latest JDK version.

Step 2: Install Java

Open the downloaded JDK installer and follow the on-screen instructions.

Step 3: Verify Java Installation

java --version

Step 4: Download and Install XAMPP

Go to Apache Friends and download the latest version of XAMPP.

Step 5: Open XAMPP

Search for "XAMPP" in the start menu and open the XAMPP Control Panel.

Step 6: Start MySQL and Apache Services

In the XAMPP Control Panel, click Start next to MySQL and Apache services.

Step 7: Install Angular CLI

Download Node.js and install it.

node -v
npm install -g @angular/cli

Step 8: Create Database in phpMyAdmin

Open phpMyAdmin, click New, go to the Databases tab, type librarylab, and click Create.

Step 9: Download Maven

Go to Maven’s official website and download the latest version.

Step 10: Install Maven

Add Maven’s bin directory to the system environment variables.

Step 11: Generate JAR File

mvn package

Step 12: Run Spring Boot Application

java -jar springbootlibrary-lab-codecanyon-0.0.1-SNAPSHOT.jar

Step 13: Run Angular Application

npm install
ng serve

Open the browser and go to http://localhost:4200/
